components.gap: Policy 7 retains the obligation that every role of the triple bar other than elementary equivalence be typed, scoped and recorded in the registry. The new convention and intake record seven roles, but on-route uses with other roles still have no record: the object-language Presburger congruence predicate (parts/p05/decidable-arithmetics.tex:17); rank-m elementary equivalence written equiv_m (annex/p03/editorial-proofs.tex:457), which collides untyped with the registered many-one equiv_m; the Reichenbach equivalence connective (parts/p15/reichenbach-probability-logic.tex:172); the Carnap equivalences in parts/p15/systematic-power.tex:48,64; the Kamp/LTL equivalences and the definitional invariant in parts/p09/logic-in-computer-science.tex:657-661,1864; the KLM source satisfaction sign s equiv alpha (annex/p08/klm-preferential-representation.tex:427); and identically-equal functions in P15 (characteristic-function-criteria-and-moments.tex:288,495). The intake also says the modular sign is used only once, in lem:goedel-beta, and the Presburger use contradicts this. The role/scope records are therefore incomplete.
